title: EchoKV: Self-Corrective KV Cache Eviction via Iterative Query Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.05903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV cache eviction is not merely a token-ranking problem: the workspace retained for generating eviction queries also determines the quality of those queries. Consequently, an early workspace error can distort later query observations and reinforce an incorrect final eviction decision, particularly when evidence is dispersed across a long context. We present EchoKV, which discovers and addresses this failure mode with iterative correction. It initializes a feedback-compatible bootstrap workspace using proposals at future decode positions, then uses early decode-generated queries to recover the workspace before the remaining lookahead steps. It uses the same number of workspace forward passes as LAQ while adding a tensor re-scoring operation for workspace repair. translated_title: EchoKV：通过迭代查询反馈实现自纠错的KV缓存驱逐
translated_abstract: KV缓存驱逐不仅仅是一个token排序问题：为生成驱逐查询而保留的工作区同样决定了这些查询的质量。因此，早期的工作区错误可能会扭曲后续的查询观察，并强化一个错误的最终驱逐决策，尤其当证据分散在长上下文中时尤为明显。我们提出了EchoKV，它通过迭代修正来发现并解决这一失效模式。EchoKV利用未来解码位置的提议初始化一个兼容反馈的引导工作区，然后在剩余的前瞻步骤之前，利用早期解码生成的查询来恢复工作区。它使用与LAQ相同数量的工作区前向传递次数，同时仅增加一个用于工作区修复的张量重新评分操作。在LongBench（16个任务，Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上，EchoKV在多个需要分散证据的任务上相比LAQ展现出显著提升，包括多……
tldr: EchoKV通过迭代查询反馈机制发现并修复KV缓存驱逐中早期工作区错误导致的决策偏差，在与LAQ相同的计算开销下，在证据分散的长上下文任务上取得显著改进。
en_tdlr: EchoKV is a self-corrective KV cache eviction method that iteratively repairs workspace errors using decode-generated query feedback, achieving notable improvements over LAQ on long-context tasks with dispersed evidence at the same computational cost.
